section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), a 13-item instrument used to measure positive body image through appreciation, care, and protection of the body. The BAS demonstrates strong psychometric properties including internal consistency (α = .93–.94) and temporal stability (r = .90), with evidence of factorial validity across both male and female adult samples. The section notes that the BAS will be used in a future study with Brazilian young adolescents using a translated version.
